_comment: Work that waits to be taken (Expansion 6 C.2; game/story/work.py; ADVENTURES.md 5.15 and 8.10). The weekly offers are gone: a faction you have joined sends a commission from its goals now and then, and a person whose town has a real need asks you themselves (a plea). Each giver has their own choice in a conversation. Contracts come in C.3.
